name: @jskswamy/pi-refactor
description: Semantic refactoring opportunity detection. Scans committed code for structural duplication (Fowler catalog), code smells (Fowler/Beck), GoF design pattern opportunities, SOLID/DRY principle violations, and language-idiomatic anti-patterns (Go, Python, TypeScript). Creates beads issues with TDD-first refactoring plans. Run on demand with /refactor:scan.
